owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

approveAndReleaseMilestone(uint256).notice: Payer approves current milestone -> releases funds once both parties have signed both documents.

createDeal(string[],uint256[],address[],.notice: Creates an escrow deal backed by ERC20 token, submits Document A, and signs it.

feeRecipient().notice: Dedicated treasury address for collecting fees

raiseDispute(uint256,string).notice: Raises a dispute if an issue arises between payer and payee.

resolveDispute(uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: Allows arbitration court to resolve a dispute on the REMAINING balance.

setFeeRecipient(address).notice: Allows the contract owner to update the treasury fee recipient address.

withdraw().notice: Pull-pattern claim function for users to claim owed tokens.
